senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; זוד)premeditated, conscious sin, opp. שְׁגָגָה.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:13">Ab. IV, 13</cite> a scholar’s error in teaching <he>עולה ז׳</he> is accounted for a wilful wrong.

<cite ref="Keritot 25b:62">Ker. 25ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>דבר שזְדוֹנוֹ כרת</he> a sin which if wilfully committed, is punished with extinction, <cite ref="Shabbat 69a:1">Sabb. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>דבר שחייבים על ז׳ וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 69a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>בזְדוֹן שבת</he> when he is fully conscious that this is a Sabbath day (whereon certain labors are forbidden); a. fr.—Pl. <he>זְדוֹנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 33b:3">B. Mets. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>ששגגות … כז׳</he> to whom errors are accounted &c.—
